name: Button Set
description: A complete button system with primary, secondary, ghost, outline and destructive variants, three sizes, loading and disabled states and full icon support.
usage: Import ButtonSet and render <ButtonSet variant="primary" size="md">Save</ButtonSet>. Pick variant (primary|secondary|ghost|outline|destructive) and size (sm|md|lg). Add loading to show a spinner and block clicks (optionally loadingText), disabled to disable, leftIcon/rightIcon for icons, iconOnly with an aria-label for square icon buttons, and fullWidth to stretch. It forwards refs and spreads all native button props.
